title: Natural ventilation element objectives
text: O 4.2.1 Development maximises the number of apartments with natural ventilation. O 4.2.2 Individual dwellings are designed to optimise natural ventilation of habitable rooms. O 4.2.3 Single aspect apartments are designed to maximise and benefit from natural ventilation.
notes: Objectives the Acceptable Outcomes of this element fall back to; text cleaned of column interleaving.
